metadata.file_name: 173. Mang et al. (2026). Sampling Weights in Multilevel Modelling: An Investigation Using PISA Sampling Structures.pdf
metadata.title: Sampling weights in multilevel modelling: an investigation using PISA sampling structures

design_fields.q1_rationale: Publisher full text: methodological simulation of weighting schemes under PISA sampling structures; no student achievement outcome is modeled as a substantive endpoint.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Publisher full text: compares alternative weighting schemes in a simulation; Q2 yes/no use of sampling weights in a substantive ILSA analysis is not applicable.
design_fields.q3_rationale: Publisher full text: methodological comparison of hierarchical weighting schemes, not a substantive student-level analysis to code for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies beyond the simulation context.
